title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/2362 of 26 October 2026 amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility

paras.text: Official Journal of the European Union
EN L series

sections.heading: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility

paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on European Union, and in particular Articles 28(1), 41(2), 42(4) and 30(1) thereof,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to the proposal from the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, with the support of the Commission,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 3

paras.text: Whereas:
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 4
amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 5

paras.text: Council Decision (CFSP) 2024/890 ( 1 ) , amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 ( 2 ) establishing a European Peace Facility (EPF), increased the financial ceiling of the EPF by an amount of EUR 5 000 million (in current prices) dedicated to continuing to address the needs of the Armed Forces of Ukraine through support for the provision of both lethal and non-lethal military support and training (the so-called ‘Ukraine Assistance Fund’, UAF). The annual ceilings for commitments established in Annex I of Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 were adapted by Decision (CFSP) 2024/890 to allow for a mobilisation of the UAF in three years, from 2025 to 2027.
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 6
amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 7

paras.text: In view of the political agreement reached by the Political and Security Committee (PSC) on 25 September 2026 on the mobilisation of the EPF funds available for Ukraine, including under the UAF, it is necessary to revise the distribution of the annual ceilings for commitments of Decision (CFSP) 2021/509.
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 8
amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 9

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 10

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility, para 11

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 is amended as follows:
In Article 2, a title is inserted, to read as follows: ‘Article 2 Financial ceiling’ ;

Annex I is replaced by the following: ‘ANNEX I ANNUAL FINANCIAL CEILINGS The annual appropriations shall be authorised within the limits of the following amounts, without prejudice to Article 17(3) and (3a), and subject to Article 73(2) and (10): Current prices, in million euro 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 2027 Current prices 399 591 971 2 082 1 644 5 079 6 274 ’.
Current prices
This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its adoption.
Done at Luxembourg, 26 October 2026.
For the Council
The President
M. HEYDON

( 1 ) Council Decision (CFSP) 2024/890 of 18 March 2024 amending Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 establishing a European Peace Facility ( OJ L, 2024/890, 19.3.2024, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec/2024/890/oj ).

( 2 ) Council Decision (CFSP) 2021/509 of 22 March 2021 establishing a European Peace Facility, and repealing Decision (CFSP) 2015/528 ( OJ L 102, 24.3.2021, p. 14 , ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec/2021/509/oj ).
